title: NOCO SMP 3
description:
Mods for Noco Smp3, its designed for a perfect vanilla plus experience on the Community Server of the streamer nurnoco.
Enjoy, building, exploring and meeting new friends with this chill extended  vanilla pack!
body:
Noco SMP 3 Pack is a carefully balanced survival modpack centered around building, exploration, and community gameplay. The pack is designed to preserve the classic vanilla Minecraft feeling while improving multiplayer convenience, performance, and long-term playability.
Features


🏠 Protected Survival Experience
Land claim systems help keep bases and builds safe, creating a fair and friendly SMP environment for everyone.


🧭 Enhanced Exploration
Waystones and exploration-focused improvements make traveling across the world easier without removing the survival aspect of the game.


⚒️ Vanilla+ Gameplay
Carefully selected mods expand the Minecraft experience while staying true to the original progression and atmosphere.


✨ Quality of Life Improvements
Includes useful utilities, smoother inventory management, multiplayer enhancements, and other features that make everyday gameplay more enjoyable.


🎮 Optimized Performance
The modpack is optimized for stable FPS and smooth gameplay, even when using high-end shaders.


🌍 Community Focused SMP
Built for cooperative multiplayer, community projects, towns, events, and relaxed survival gameplay with friends and viewers.


🎥 Streamer Hosted
Officially hosted by streamer nurnoco.


Why Play Noco SMP 3?
Noco SMP 3 Pack is ideal for players looking for a stable and polished Vanilla+ SMP experience with strong community features, balanced gameplay, and excellent performance. Whether you enjoy building massive projects, exploring with friends, or simply relaxing on a long-term survival server, this pack offers a smooth and enjoyable experience for all playstyles.
